intro: Every engagement is scoped to your actual infrastructure, not a one size fits all rate card. Here is roughly what each way of working together looks like at each level of complexity.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: One application, one environment, no separate staging yet.
tiers.comparison: A pre-seed MVP that just landed its first real users.

tiers.name: Growing
tiers.description: Multiple environments, each with its own database and configuration.
tiers.comparison: A funded startup's product a year or two post launch.
included: Database servers or microservice setup per environment
Full observability across every environment: metrics, logs, dashboards, and error-rate alerting

tiers.name: Scaling
tiers.description: Multiple applications or services, multiple environments, compliance or reliability requirements that matter.
tiers.comparison: A Series A+ startup with an engineering team but no dedicated platform engineer.
included: Everything in Growing, across multiple applications or services
Cross-service observability: distributed tracing across services, plus SLA-based alerting
